h: The Gaze of Elazar Gives Yehoshua the Power to Inherit

p: "These are the names of the men
who shall apportion the land to you:
Elazar the Kohen and Yehoshua bin Nun;
they were the ones who apportioned the inheritance to Yisrael,
that is, they selected a portion for each one
that is, to conquer the land
from the hand of the Canaanites
זֶה הָיָה עַל יְדֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּלְבַד
and Elazar did not go out to war;
so why is he mentioned here,
"And he shall stand before Elazar the Kohen,"
וְאִיתָא (מִדְרַשׁ רַבָּה פִּנְחָס, בְּמִדְבַּר רַבָּה כא, טו)
and it says (Midrash Rabbah, Pinchas, Bamidbar Rabbah 21:15):
"The honor does not depart from your father's house,
for even Yehoshua, who stands in your place,
shall stand before Elazar the Kohen"
that is only to inquire of the Urim v'Tumim,
וְשָׁאַל לוֹ בְּמִשְׁפַּט הָאוּרִים לִפְנֵי ה׳
"And he shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before Hashem";
but not to take possession and to conquer.
But there it is also written:
"By his word they shall go out
and by his word they shall come in, he," etc.;
And this is why it is written,
"And he shall stand before Elazar the Kohen."
And why did he need to stand
Let him ask him, and he will tell him
the counsel of Hashem through the judgment of the Urim!
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ בְּפָרָה אֲדוּמָּה
along the lines of what they said about the Parah Adumah,
"And he shall slaughter it before him"
But the procedure of the Parah Adumah
is to rectify the damage of the Golden Calf,
indeed, you shall die like men" (Tehillim 82:7).
Through the procedure of the Parah Adumah,
which purifies from the impurity of the dead,
the damage is rectified at its root.
And to rectify the sin at its root
it was necessary that Elazar watch;
וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאוֹר כִּי טוֹב
"And God saw the light, that it was good":
פֵּירוּשׁ שֶׁעַל יְדֵי רְאִיַּית הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
meaning, that through Hashem Yisbarach's seeing
through His seeing, as it were,
He instilled in it the light "that it was good."
regarding all the works of Creation,
"And God saw that it was good";
into every detail of the creation
"The eyes of Hashem are toward the tzaddikim":
something like the eyes of Hashem, as it were,
so that they too are able
to instill through their seeing the light "that it was good,"
everything is rectified at the root,
which is the thorn of the yud,
For this reason it was necessary here too
this power is given to the seed of Aharon.
This is what Hashem Yisbarach said
that the honor does not depart from your father's house,
for even Yehoshua, who stands in your place,
shall stand before Elazar the Kohen;
he will instill in him the light "that it was good."
"By his word they shall go out
and by his word they shall come in"
נֶגֶד מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר מִתְּחִלָּה (שָׁם כז, יז)
corresponding to what was said at first (Bamidbar 27:17):
"And who shall take them out and who shall bring them in";
שֶׁזֶּה יִהְיֶה עַל פִּיו שֶׁל אֶלְעָזָר
that this will be by the word of Elazar.
This is along the lines of what is said:
"By the word of Hashem they would encamp,
וְעַל פִּי ה׳ יִסָּעוּ (שָׁם ט, כ)
and by the word of Hashem they would journey" (Bamidbar 9:20),
that the encampment and the journey
were by the word of Hashem
(and this was explained in Parshas Beha'alosecha);
the journeys and the encampments by the word of Hashem.
So too regarding Yehoshua it is written,
"who shall take them out and who shall bring them in";
the conquest of the nations will come about.
does not depart from your father's house:
"And he shall stand before Elazar the Kohen."
he will instill through his seeing
that he will take them out and he will bring them in;
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה יִהְיֶה לוֹ כֹּחַ
and through this he will have the power
"By his word they shall go out
and by his word they shall come in"
that is, by the word of Elazar;
"he and all the Children of Israel"

p: Now this is the power of the root
וְזֶה קָאֵי עַל תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
and this refers to Torah she'b'al peh
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב קלז, ב)
And Yehoshua apportioned the land to Yisrael,
selecting for each one of Yisrael
his portion in Torah she'b'al peh,
for it is the register of Eretz Yisrael";
that is, the portion in Torah she'b'al peh
(and this has been explained many times).
And this power came to Yehoshua
who instilled in him this power,
that he be able to rectify down to the root;
he would be able to conquer the nations.
"who shall apportion the land to you:
Elazar the Kohen and Yehoshua bin Nun."
וְכָל זֶה הָיָה כֹּחַ מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ
And all this was the power of Moshe Rabbeinu,
for he was the secret of Da'as,
and his generation was called the Generation of Knowledge
(as they said in the Midrash Rabbah and Tanchuma, Chukas);
"And by knowledge the chambers are filled
with all precious and pleasant wealth."
that is, the Torah she'b'al peh
שֶׁעַל זֶה אָמְרוּ (שָׁם, בְּמִדְבַּר רַבָּה יט, ו)
about which they said (there, Bamidbar Rabbah 19:6):
וְכָל יְקָר רָאֲתָה עֵינוֹ (אִיּוֹב כח, י)
"'And his eye saw every precious thing' (Iyov 28:10)
this is Rabbi Akiva and his colleagues."
is the power of Torah she'b'al peh
to the tribes and to all Yisrael;
(מִדְרַשׁ רַבָּה וְתַנְחוּמָא שָׁם ד; תַּנְחוּמָא מַסְעֵי ד)
(Midrash Rabbah and Tanchuma there, 4; Tanchuma Masei 4):
in the merit of the Torah,
'For it is pleasant if you keep them within you'";
and that is Torah she'b'al peh
and this is what it says,

p: וּבְמִדְרַשׁ רַבָּה (מַטּוֹת, בְּמִדְבַּר רַבָּה כב, ה)
And in the Midrash Rabbah (Matos, Bamidbar Rabbah 22:5):
לֹא יִגְרַע מִצַּדִּיק עֵינוֹ וְגוֹ׳ (אִיּוֹב לו, ז)
"'He does not withdraw His eye from the tzaddik,' etc. (Iyov 36:7)
to teach you that Moshe longed
to see the vengeance on Midian," etc.;
'The tzaddik will rejoice when he sees vengeance'
'he will wash his feet in the blood of the wicked'
But what difference does it make
whether he sees the vengeance on Midian
and through the vengeance on Midian,
that is, on the root of the kelipah
"he will wash his feet in the blood of the wicked":
וְהַיְינוּ אַף מַה שֶּׁהָאָדָם דָּשׁ בַּעֲקֵבָיו
that is, even what a person tramples with his heels;
that is, to rectify everything at its root.
For this the seeing was needed;
and about this it says "will rejoice,"
when the heart is made entirely upright,
"And joy for the upright of heart."
And this is "The tzaddik will rejoice
"He does not withdraw His eye from the tzaddik,"
And through his seeing the vengeance,
"he will wash his feet in the blood of the wicked";
"And who knows the knowledge of the Most High";
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמַר (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קצג, ב)
and this is what it says (Zohar III 193b):
"But among the nations of the world there arose
the aspect of Da'as of the kelipah,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (שָׁם קצד, א)
as is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 194a):
And this is why he longed
to see specifically the vengeance on Midian,
and to destroy all their power;
and for this there was specifically needed
and "he will wash his feet," etc.
that he rectified everything at the root,
and he gave power to Yehoshua
to take possession of the land,
